goal: Materialize the deterministic protected first semantic-batch input configuration required before Issue #67 can freeze and execute the first semantic maintenance batch.

verified_facts.statement: Issue #69 was the sole READY task at claim time; Issue #66 was closed/completed, PR #68 merged at d9c0745741315cfd5f3d322e77949d1040dabb9a, and post-merge Infrastructure CI 32019615824 succeeded on that exact merge SHA; Issue #67 remained blocked and unclaimed.

The frozen first-batch configuration identity is sbic1-e3ef5c9f6753c8413cdac51b244ac7c4916302c82d75af722658dff7cdbc52d9. It binds 19 exact ordered public-disclosure-safe sources totaling 176188 UTF-8 bytes; the 17-KD frontier totals 174209 bytes with digest f7aa42bd6573a40e92dc61b755d17aac6a219d8218c8bdfca99cec2991bc9fad and full source frontier digest 0313558479287a3afa6025bd2dbc5ee65ac149eae184b7ab03f4e6f970245f57.

The architecture-authorized first trigger is knowledge_health/coverage with exact zero previous accepted semantic batch/coverage inventory, exact source readback heads control=d9c0745741315cfd5f3d322e77949d1040dabb9a, context=d651f40d0bb3a3ef0e52fca95e5400ed3db3d772, product=8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4, and trigger evidence digest 1a57aadca03dfe936b08d55de65602314a7b5aeb57e34fbeb3f7923f0eda8dd1.

The exact partition limit is 65536 UTF-8 bytes. The largest frozen source is 22048 bytes, so the first frontier has no oversized-single-source blocker; existing P5R1 PARTITION_SOURCE_OVERSIZE remains the fail-closed behavior if that invariant is violated.

state/current.json is excluded from current lifecycle/DAG authority, tasks/I09-0048/context.json is excluded as a first-batch selector, later material belongs to a later batch, and the actual hwm-semantic-batch-manifest/v1 is intentionally materialized later by Issue #67 from exact runtime heads.

The first implementation source CI 32026457447 failed closed on exact head d53d985ed6cf2002bee502ff950c9791fefa4a01 because the adapter omitted P5R1 source content and the in-progress KD used an invalid status spelling; neither failure was accepted as completion. The remediated exact-head source CI 32026746411 then succeeded on 2cbf25d45deb764f0d8573d018c06bafa73c04ea with full repository discovery: 419 tests passed.

decisions.decision: Add hwm-semantic-batch-input-config/v1 as a strict versioned configuration contract without changing P5R1 manifest/result/coverage semantics.
decisions.rationale: Issue #69 selects and validates exact protected inputs; Issue #67 owns the later frozen manifest and semantic maintenance execution.

decisions.decision: Bind every source to repository, exact source commit, path, Git blob SHA, content SHA-256, UTF-8 byte size, media type, stable source_id, public-data classification and deterministic ordering key.
decisions.rationale: This removes mutable glob/discovery and makes replay/source substitution fail closed.

decisions.decision: Keep runtime execution heads separate from immutable source heads.
decisions.rationale: This avoids a self-referential requirement to know Issue #69's future merge SHA while still making future manifest identity change when runtime heads change.

decisions.decision: Preserve the initial failed source CI as audit evidence and accept only the remediated exact-head green run as implementation validation.
decisions.rationale: The project completion model is fail closed: failed exact-head validation cannot be reinterpreted as success.
